en.title: Map of an FAO Major Fishing Area and Its Subareas
en.description:
This function maps one FAO major marine fishing area with its subareas, divisions or
subdivisions, labelled with their codes (e.g. 27.4, the North Sea), from the boundaries
bundled with the package (`inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp`, FAO, CC BY 4.0). When the
ggOceanMaps package (Vihtakari 2026, <https://github.com/MikkoVihtakari/ggOceanMaps>) is
installed, the map is drawn on its bathymetric base map: polar stereographic for areas reaching
beyond 60 degrees of latitude (e.g. area 27), else in longitude and latitude, with the depth
from the low-resolution ETOPO 2022 relief model bundled with ggOceanMaps (no download needed).
Without ggOceanMaps, the land of Natural Earth is drawn in a Lambert azimuthal equal-area
projection centred on the area, without depth.
en.details: The official FAO map of the area is linked in the result (`fao_map`); see `fao_areas()`.
en.value:
Invisibly, a list with `map` (the ggplot object), `units` (one row per unit: `code`,
`level`, `name_en`), `engine`, `fao_map` (link to the official FAO map of the area) and
`sources` (the boundaries, base map and depth data used, to cite with the map).

arguments.area:
The FAO major marine fishing area: its code (e.g. 27) or English name (e.g.
"Atlantic, Northeast").
arguments.level:
The units drawn inside the area: "subarea" (default), "division",
"subdivision" or "none" (the outline of the area only). Areas without units at the level
asked for are drawn with their outline only.
arguments.bathymetry: A logical value. If TRUE (default), the depth is shown (ggOceanMaps only).
arguments.labels: A logical value. If TRUE (default), the units are labelled with their codes.
arguments.engine:
How the map is drawn: "auto" (default, ggOceanMaps when installed, else "sf"),
"ggOceanMaps" or "sf".
arguments.plot: A logical value. If TRUE (default), the map is saved in `figures/png/area/`.
arguments.table: A logical value. If TRUE (default), the table of units is saved in `tables/`.
arguments.lang:
The language of the map text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or "both"
(Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
`fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).
arguments.pptx:
A logical value. If TRUE, the map is also saved as an editable PowerPoint file in
`figures/pptx/area/`. Default is the value set with `fao_settings()` (FALSE unless changed).

zh.title: FAO主要渔区及其分区地图
zh.description: 该函数绘制一个FAO主要海洋渔区及其亚区（subarea）、区（division）或分区（subdivision），并标出其代码（例如27.4为北海），边界来自本包自带的渔区图层（inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp，FAO，CC BY 4.0）。安装了ggOceanMaps包（Vihtakari 2026，<https://github.com/MikkoVihtakari/ggOceanMaps>）时，地图画在它的海底地形底图上：延伸到纬度60度以外的渔区（例如27区）采用极地立体投影，其他渔区采用经纬度坐标；水深取自ggOceanMaps自带的低分辨率ETOPO 2022地形模型（无需下载）。未安装ggOceanMaps时，以渔区为中心的兰伯特方位等积投影绘制Natural Earth的陆地，不显示水深。
zh.details: 该渔区的FAO官方地图链接在返回结果的`fao_map`中；见`fao_areas()`。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含`map`（ggplot对象）、`units`（每个单元一行：`code`、`level`、`name_en`）、`engine`（绘图方式）、`fao_map`（该渔区FAO官方地图的链接）和`sources`（所用的边界、底图和水深数据，引用地图时一并引用）。

arguments.area: FAO主要海洋渔区：代码（例如27）或英文名称（例如"Atlantic, Northeast"）。
arguments.level: 渔区内绘制的单元："subarea"（亚区，默认）、"division"（区）、"subdivision"（分区）或"none"（只画渔区边界）。没有该级单元的渔区只画其边界。
arguments.bathymetry: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时显示水深（仅限ggOceanMaps）。
arguments.labels: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，在各单元上标出其代码。
arguments.engine: 绘图方式："auto"（默认，已安装ggOceanMaps时用它，否则用"sf"）、"ggOceanMaps"或"sf"。
arguments.plot: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，地图保存在figures/png/area/。
arguments.table: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，单元表保存在tables/。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。
arguments.pptx: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，地图还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/area/。默认为`fao_settings()`中的设置（未更改时为FALSE）。
